source: blab's attentionComp experiment (field mode, per-trial pertAmp/pertPhi, 125 mel, fb 3 with the bundled babble at 0.02), after free-speech's measureFormants calibration block; the only change is removing the runner's two clear lines.

setparam.pertAmp: 125 (all 257 values) on shift trials, 0 on noShift trials
setparam.datapb: bundled babble mtbabble48k.wav, loaded with free-speech get_noiseSource

switching: calibration block with measureFormants.ost/.pcf (bShift 0); then AudapterIO('init', p) and field-mode pertAmp/pertPhi set before every trial; reset() before every trial. Expected: the runner clears the OST and PCF first; observed: it does not
input: synthetic "head"-like /E/ vowel, 0.40 s, F0 205-212 Hz, formants [731 2058 2979 4000] Hz
playground_left_out: the masking noise: the Playground plays its own generated pink noise, not the lab's babble file
the trial sequence: the link loads one trial's settings; run several trials as one session in the Playground to see carry-over
